name: Escape Room (VST3)
description: Five noise cells, a playable filter, three traps — and a SIGIL, a number from 0 to 63 that seeds eight modulation wires deterministically. The same sigil is the same machine, on any computer, forever. The panel is cryptic on purpose: the knobs are named ALEPH and BETH, and the real values only appear while you turn one. There is a legend, if you can find it.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260826.5 · free download · 26-page manual included.
